_note: Stable warning codes for uika validators. Codes never change meaning; retire a code instead of reusing it. severity: warn keeps the exit code 0 (the validate contract); error would be reserved for a future breaking check. Messages match the CLI text; {placeholders} are filled at run time.

SKV001.when: The SKILL.md frontmatter `name` differs from the skill's folder name, or is missing (no frontmatter block reads as name "undefined").
SKV001.fix: Set `name:` in the frontmatter to the exact folder name, or rename the folder. Add a `---` frontmatter block if there is none.

SKV002.message: {key}: unquoted value contains ": " or " #" (invalid YAML; quote it)
SKV002.when: A frontmatter value that is not quoted or a block scalar contains ": " or " #". Harnesses then fail to parse the YAML and drop the whole frontmatter.
SKV002.fix: Wrap the value in double quotes (escape inner quotes), or use a `|` or `>` block scalar.

SKV003.when: The frontmatter has no `description`, or it is empty.
SKV003.fix: Add a `description:` that says when to use the skill; harnesses route on it.

SKV004.when: The frontmatter `description` is longer than 1024 characters.
SKV004.fix: Shorten the description to 1024 characters or fewer; move detail into the SKILL.md body.
